symptom: Opening a vacation, event, or spa business from cards could show a blank browser tab for several seconds before the detail page appeared.
expected_behavior: Internal place links must navigate in the existing application tab, show immediate localized progress feedback, and retain visible content until the destination is ready.
environment: VII production v746 and local candidate branch fix/contextual-deal-landings-20261101 on 2026-11-01, desktop and 390px mobile navigation.

steps: Open a search result or deal slider
Observe the tab and content while the detail route loads
reproduction.evidence: Property cards, spa deal cards, and verified event deal cards contained target=_blank on internal application URLs.

observations.observation: Internal business links explicitly requested a new browser tab.
observations.evidence: Static source inspection found target=_blank in property-card.tsx, spa-package-deals.tsx, event-last-minute.tsx and home-showcase.tsx.

observations.observation: Direct production detail requests had measurable server response latency.
observations.evidence: Cold curl samples returned first bytes in approximately 0.75 to 1.10 seconds, which becomes a visible white interval in a newly opened tab.

hypotheses.mechanism: Internal target=_blank links bypass client navigation and prefetch, opening an empty document until the full route responds.
hypotheses.prediction: Removing target=_blank will keep one page open and allow immediate in-app progress feedback while the route resolves.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Click representative vacation, event and spa links in Playwright and record tab count, target attribute and first feedback time.
hypotheses.result: All three links kept one page, had no target attribute, and showed the progress indicator in 31 to 107 milliseconds.

hypotheses.mechanism: The blank interval is caused only by broken media or a client rendering crash on the destination page.
hypotheses.prediction: Destination requests would fail or remain blank even after same-tab navigation and loading feedback were installed.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Wait for the destination H1 after each repaired navigation and verify the final route renders normally.
hypotheses.result: Vacation, event and spa destination pages all rendered a visible H1 and completed navigation successfully.

fix.change: Removed new-tab behavior from internal business cards, added route-level place skeletons, and added a global same-origin navigation progress indicator.
fix.evidence: Automated browser regression showed one tab, immediate feedback under 110 milliseconds and successful final H1 for all three business worlds.

affected_family: Vacation cards in search results, sliders and rating showcases
Event cards in results and verified last-minute sliders
Spa cards and dated spa package deal sliders
Vacation, event and discovery place detail route loading states

regression_checks.check: Vacation search card to business detail
regression_checks.evidence: One page remained open, progress appeared in 31ms and the destination H1 rendered.

regression_checks.check: Event listing card to event detail
regression_checks.evidence: One page remained open, progress appeared in 107ms and the destination H1 rendered.

regression_checks.check: Spa listing card to spa detail
regression_checks.evidence: One page remained open, progress appeared in 92ms and the destination H1 rendered.

remaining_unknowns: Production-ready timing must be remeasured after the candidate is deployed because local development compilation is slower than the production worker.
authorization_boundary: Repair internal navigation and loading feedback, verify locally, and prepare a release without changing DNS or supplier data.
